name: e46-headunit
description: Custom infotainment system for a BMW E46, running on Linux.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n core,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w core" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -k -n core,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w core" "npm run dev:browser -w ui"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n core,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w core" "npm run start -w ui"
